message: Thanks, Clancy -- I've used the `del` tag to clarify, and apologize for the mistrepresentation. And thanks, Kelly, as well: as you know, your comment on my less than civil, reasoned, and reasonable response to your article several years ago taught me something about how to try to promote those qualities in scholarly discourse, whether on weblogs or in articles. I'm grateful to you for being a gracious interlocutor, and thinking about the blog traffic around your article helped me temper my response to Sirc's occasionally intemperate review.
